ninth-sister--hulking-inquisitor.text:
Overwhelm
When Played: An opponent discards a card from their hand. You may deal damage equal to its cost divided as you choose among any number of units.

0-0-0--translation-and-torture.text: On Attack: You may put a Aggression card from your discard pile on the bottom of your deck. If you do, deal 1 damage to each enemy base.

bt-1--blastomech.text: On Attack: Discard a card from your deck. If it's Aggression, you may deal 1 damage to a ground unit.

beguile.text: Look at an opponent's hand. Then, choose a non-leader unit that opponent controls that costs 6 or less and return it to its owner's hand.

moff-gideon--remnant-commander.text:
Sentinel (Enemy units in this arena must attack a Sentinel when they attack you.)
When Defeated: You may return a non-<uq> Imperial unit from your discard pile to your hand.

trask-walker.text: When Played/On Attack: Choose a unit in your discard pile that costs 7 or less. Either put that card on the bottom of your deck and heal 3 damage from your base or return it to your hand.

interrogation-droid.text: When Played: Exhaust an enemy unit. If you do and that unit costs 3 or less, its controller discards a card from their hand.

merrin--alone-with-the-dead.text: On Attack: You may discard a card from your hand. If you do, deal 2 damage to a unit.

reckless-sacrifice.text: Discard a unit from your hand. Deal 5 damage to a unit that costs more than the discarded card.

remnant-lookouts.text: When Played: Look at an opponent's hand. You may discard a card from it. If you do, they draw a card.

mid-rim-sharpshooter.text:
Saboteur (When this unit attacks, ignore Sentinel and defeat the defender's Shields.)
When Played: You may pay 1 resource. If you do, an opponent discards a card from their hand.

qui-gon-jinn--the-negotiations-will-be-s.text:
Ambush
When Defeated: You may choose a non-leader ground unit. Its owner puts it on the top or bottom of their deck.

hold-for-questioning.text: Exhaust an enemy unit. If you do, look at its controller's hand and discard a card from it that shares an aspect with that unit.
